name: Silvermore's Educational Journey
source:
Silvermore's Educational Journey was ranked 4th in the Lesser Poland regional stage of the contest.

The premise of the game was to make expanding your English vocabulary fun and easy.

[From [url=https://storybound.itch.io/sej]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
西尔弗莫尔的教育之旅在小波兰地区比赛中排名第四。

该游戏的宗旨是让你轻松有趣地扩展英语词汇量。

[来自[url=https://storybound.itch.io/sej]Itch.io[/url]]
